content:
The maintainers welcome Michael Rothgang as our latest member of the Mathlib maintainer team.

Additionally, we welcome Thomas Murrills as our latest Mathlib reviewer.

We haven't posted a welcome message for our other new reviewers, but the team has been steadily growing. This year, Yakov Pechersky joined us in August, Robin Carlier and Jovan Gerbscheid in June and Etienne Marion in January.

The maintainers are glad to welcome Filippo A. E. Nuccio to the Mathlib maintainer team.

We also welcome Aaron Liu, who joined the reviewer team in January.

The maintainers welcome @Jiang Jiedong and @Hannah Scholz as our latest reviewers.

Since the last announcement, two more reviewers joined the team. @Miyahara Kō joined in March and @Monica Omar in April. Welcome to both of you!
Since the last announcement, two more reviewers joined @Yongxi Lin (Aaron) joined the team in July, @Edison Xie in August. Welcome to both of you!
